decisions.decision: Director Doreen Noble will negotiate with the Town Manager to increase the Eagle House van/building staff hours to 10-14 hours per week.
decisions.quote: ms. noble will negotiate with the town manager on having his hours increased at the eagle house to 10-14 hrs. per week.

decisions.decision: Director will advertise for two per diem drivers, in-house first and public if no qualified applicants.
decisions.quote: ms. noble stated that she will be advertising for two "per deim" drivers beginning with an "in house" advertisement then it will go public if there are no qualified applicants.

decisions.decision: Director will advertise for one or two per diem Meal Site Coordinators for kitchen back-up, in-house first and public if no qualified applicants.
decisions.quote: ms. noble will be advertising for one or two "per deim" coordinators in order to have back up in the kitchen.

decisions.decision: FY13 COA sub-committee assignments were set as listed (Board Development, Bylaw, Advocacy, Finance, Directors Evaluation).
decisions.quote: coa sub-committee re-assignments for fy13 are as follows:

budget_items.topic: Kitchen equipment replacement (refrigerator, steam table, oven) and salad bar
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Capitol Planning approved $10K for replacing kitchen equipment; a vendor will send replacement quotes, including for a new salad bar.
budget_items.quote: capitol planning has approved $10k for the replacement of the kitchen refrigerator, steam table, & oven.

budget_items.topic: Farmer's Market coupons (MOC elder nutrition program)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Income-eligible residents each received $25 worth of Farmer's Market coupons this summer; MOC gave 12 more coupons for distribution.
budget_items.quote: participants received $25 worth of coupons which could be used at participating farmers markets for fresh produce.

budget_items.topic: Lunenburg Relief Day fundraising for the COA
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Relief Day funds for the COA reached $5K, with one later $100 check; the $12K goal has not been reached.
budget_items.quote: ms. noble stated that funds collected for the coa on lunenburg relief day amounted to $5k. one more check was received after the event in the amount of $100.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY13 Formula Grant is about $14.5K, used for Outreach Salary and Meals on Wheels mileage; the director hopes to use $4K of it for stairs between the parking lots.
budget_items.quote: this year the grant is for approximately $14.5k and is used for outreach salary and meals on wheels mileage.

budget_items.topic: Concrete ramp between upper and lower parking lots (AmeriRamp)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: AmeriRamp judged a concrete ramp not worth doing given the project's expense; no dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: he came to the conclusion that it was not worth doing considering the expense of the project.
